description: This file defines the feature for creating articles in an ASP.NET Core application using MediatR. It includes data models, validators, a command, and a handler for processing the creation of new articles with associated tags.

classes.name: Create.ArticleData
classes.description: Data transfer object for article details such as Title, Description, Body, and TagList.

classes.name: Create.ArticleDataValidator
classes.description: Validator enforcing non-null and non-empty constraints on article data fields.

classes.name: Create.Command
classes.description: Request object encapsulating article data for creation operation.

classes.name: Create.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validator applying rules to the Command including nested ArticleData validation.

classes.name: Create.Handler
classes.description: Handles the creation of an article, including author lookup, tag processing, and persisting to the database.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Asynchronous method that creates an article, associates tags, and saves data to the database.
